_comment: Integration tests: the right-hand ascent of the V model at requirement level. Each entry states which capability requirements a test validates end to end, against real collaborators (FHIR server, policy engine, database, broker). 'verifies' must reference requirement IDs that exist in specs/capabilities/. The implementing test is discovered from test code by its IT id, so this file records intent and the code records fact.

IT-001.name: A conformant ePI Bundle round-trips through create and read with no content loss

IT-002.name: A caller outside the resource affiliate or market is denied and sees nothing

IT-003.name: A content write and an access decision each produce an immutable audit record

IT-004.name: A second market is served by adding configuration alone, with no code change

IT-005.name: Malformed content is rejected with itemised located errors and leaves no partial state

IT-006.name: An attempt to mutate an existing version is rejected and history remains reconstructable

IT-007.name: A request without a valid OIDC token is rejected before reaching content

IT-008.name: Creating a document emits a content event to the backbone

IT-009.name: An invalid market definition is rejected before activation
